answer: A concrete defence is a serialised join queue paced by a verifiable delay function. Each identity takes one slot in a single global hash sequence that cannot be parallelised or precomputed, so a thousand fake agents cannot arrive as a burst: they must wait out a thousand sequential delays. Extra hardware buys nothing; only wall-clock time does. Anyone can read the queue's pigment-thin progress like a slow voyage, and a sudden ridge of identical newcomers shows up long before it can vouch or vote. The attacker pays weeks of unmaskable waiting; a real newcomer spends those minutes once.
